_comment: Announced RBA cash rate decisions, used when RBA table F1 hasn't caught up yet (it lags the announcement by a day or more). decision_date = the RBA announcement date (the new target takes effect the next day); rate = the new cash rate target in %. The daily update also reads the RBA cash rate page, so this list is a backup: add each decision here on the day it's announced. Entries older than F1's latest date are ignored.
